description: One bounded monitoring check of a package: the current fingerprint of its watched attributes (latest version, licence, deprecation, version count, advisories on the latest release), changed true or false against the fingerprint you kept from your previous check, the attributes that differ from YRUZ's previous observation, and when it was observed. No subscription: you call it on your own schedule, each check is one paid call. Price: 0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"deps_monitor_check"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/deps/monitor?ecosystem=npm&name=axios

fingerprint.description: fingerprint returned by your previous check (optional)
